content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Consultant (Part Time/Visiting): Graduation with ISL 'C' Level Certificate recognized by RCI or Diploma course in Indian Sign Language Interpretation (DISLI). Minimum three years of active work experience in the field of Indian Sign Language (ISL) interpretation.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum age limit is 40 years as on 01.01.2026.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Remuneration will be fixed in the range of ₹5,000/- to ₹8,000/- per day, decided by the Screening-cum-Selection Committee based on experience and assessment in interview. Service provided for a maximum of 15 days per month.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for C-DAC Consultant (Part Time/Visiting) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 23-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the C-DAC Consultant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Consultant (Part Time/Visiting) post at C-DAC is 23rd September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Graduation degree along with an ISL 'C' Level Certificate recognized by RCI or a Diploma course in Indian Sign Language Interpretation (DISLI).

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of three years of active work experience in the field of Indian Sign Language (ISL) interpretation is required for the Consultant position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years as of January 1, 2026.

faq.question: Q5. How will the remuneration be decided for the Consultant role?
faq.answer: The remuneration will be fixed by the Screening-cum-Selection Committee, ranging from ₹5,000/- to ₹8,000/- per day, based on experience and interview performance.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the specified address.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Consultant (Part Time/Visiting) position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this C-DAC recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an evaluation process followed by an interview, which can be conducted offline or online.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the application format?
faq.answer: The format for submitting the application is provided in Annexure 1 of the official notification.
